argv.value: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { [Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $data=@(& { Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object { !$env:SY_FILTER -or $_.TaskName.IndexOf($env:SY_FILTER,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 } | Select-Object -First ([int]$env:SY_LIMIT) TaskName,TaskPath,State }); $limited=($env:SY_LIMIT -and ($data.Count -ge [int]$env:SY_LIMIT -or @($data | Where-Object {$_.limitReached}).Count -gt 0)); @{operation=$env:SY_OPERATION;status=$(if($limited){'partial'}else{'ok'});source='Windows PowerShell 5.1 inbox modules';observedAtUtc=[datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');timeZone='UTC';count=$data.Count;limitReached=[bool]$limited;data=$data} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress } catch { $denied=($_.Exception -is [System.UnauthorizedAccessException] -or $_.FullyQualifiedErrorId -match 'Unauthorized|AccessDenied|PermissionDenied|SecurityException'); @{operation=$env:SY_OPERATION;status=$(if($denied){'access_denied'}else{'unavailable'});observedAtUtc=[datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');error=$_.Exception.Message;errorId=$_.FullyQualifiedErrorId;data=@()} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress; exit 2 }
